messages.subject: Non-linear constraints multi-group
parts:
I have two forms (child and parent) of an instrument.
There are two samples of mother-child-dyads.
The first one was asked to provide reports based on the original version. The second sample was asked to provide reports based on a modified version (item wording of children's self-report form and mothers' proxy report form was parallelized).

My job ist to compare whether the size of correlation (not covariance) between children-report and mother-report differs between the groups.

Therefore: I specified a measurement-model in lavaan. To compare correlations (instead of covariances) between the groups I was told to set nonlinear constraints like:

COV(FB_original,SB_original) = COV(FB_mod,SB_mod) * ((sqrt(VAR(FB_original))*sqrt(VAR(SB_original))) / (sqrt(VAR(FB_mod))*sqrt(VAR(SB_mod))) )

So. I added these lines to my model to label my variances and covariances of one scale called "peer" (with k_peer = Self-report and e_peer = Proxy Report)

k_peer  ~~ c(kpeer1,kpeer2)*k_peer
e_peer  ~~ c(epeer1,epeer2)*e_peer
k_peer ~~ c(covpeer1,covpeer2)*e_peer

An finally added the constraint:

covpeer1 == covpeer2 * ((sqrt(epeer1)*sqrt(kpeer1))/(sqrt(epeer2)*sqrt(kpeer2)))

I thought this would work. But the analyses are still running for more than half an hour now...

Any ideas?
